workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for all three same-date Selected objects. Q-20260908-01 read the complete controlled memory-portability study across memory representations, writer/reader directions, embedding migration, diagnostic loss and repair. Physical durability did not establish semantic portability: free-form NOTES showed strong direction-dependent swap effects that could cancel in symmetric averages; a 50/50 mixed embedding index captured only part of the full-reembedding gain despite identical vector dimensions; and retained raw source materially enabled some repair paths without guaranteeing repair across models. The bounded runtime finding is that memory inheritance after a model or embedding upgrade should be a governed migration admission with direction-specific semantic probes, representation/producer/embedder provenance and a tested recovery route. Q-20260908-02 read the complete controlled interchangeability study across placebo, swap, swap-cleared, amnesia and naive conditions, formation history, coordination metrics, leadership effects and recovery. Role-matched swaps preserved much task outcome while raising communication cost per progress by approximately 16–63%; team age, coupling and coordination-centrality increased partner-specific residue, and task score recovered earlier than coordination efficiency. The bounded architecture finding is that role/capability compatibility and destination-team coordination compatibility are separate admission questions, with relationship-specific memory requiring scoped handoff rather than blind inheritance. Q-20260908-03 read the complete CUA-Universe primary benchmark study across shared-state GUI+CLI construction, task synthesis, Path-Steer, trajectory verification, CUA-Verse/OSWorld/OSWorld-MCP comparisons, human judge validation and limitations. GUI and CLI actions are modeled over one persistent application state; the benchmark joins screenshots, command results and exported-artifact evidence into one task trajectory, while its fine-tuned 9B model shows large hybrid-orchestration gains and transfer to an unseen MCP tool interface. The bounded engineering finding is that switching control surfaces should not split one business effect into separate execution identities: production runtimes need one cross-surface effect/provenance chain with surface-specific action evidence and explicit authoritative-state probes, while benchmark VLM verification does not prove authorization correctness, exactly-once effects or complete production auditability. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
